study type: Nested cohort study within a randomized clinical trial
exposure: Whole-body hypothermia vs. no whole-body hypothermia
outcome: Thalamic lactate to NAA peak area ratios
Death or moderate or severe disability at 18-22 months
cohort: 408 neonates born at or after 36 weeks' gestation with moderate or severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) in India, Sri Lanka, and Bangladesh
finding: Whole-body hypothermia was not associated with reductions in brain injury after HIE among neonates in South Asia, regardless of place of birth.
birth_weight: Not specified, but inborn neonates were smaller than outborn neonates (mean birth weight 2.8 kg vs. 2.9 kg)
